slides.h1: Do a fake App Review before the real one.
slides.lead: Test your app the way a reviewer will. 20 minutes now can save you weeks.
Delete the app, reinstall, sign up like a stranger. No saved logins, no test data.

slides.h2: Can you delete your account in the app?
slides.lead: Not by email. Not "contact support." Find the button in under a minute.
Every one should open, load and match your app. Broken links get noticed.
Empty states, errors, loading. A blank screen looks like a broken app.

slides.h2: Does the app do what the page says?
slides.lead: Screenshots and description should show features that actually exist today.
Mostly terms, privacy policy and account deletion. Check those twice.
